annotations.title: utilpeek: summarize a text by picking its key sentences

description: utilpeek: Summarize a text by picking its key sentences. For paper abstracts use paper_digest; for counts use text_stats. Returns an extractive summary: the most central `sentences` (or `ratio` of them) by LexRank, picked verbatim and kept in their original order, with per-sentence scores. It does not paraphrase, shorten or check facts. Typically under 0.5 s. Price: USD 0.003. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/text-summarization-api.html
